text: INC-5521 triggered: payments-api P99 latency spiked to 2147ms (threshold 500ms). Error rate at 4.2%. Correlated with deployment d4e5f6 at 14:00 UTC by @frank. Opening incident bridge.
Looking at the commit now. The deployment changed connection pool settings - reduced connectionPoolSize from 50 to 10. That's almost certainly the cause.
Confirmed in Datadog: seeing 'connection pool exhausted' errors starting at exactly 14:00:30. 847 occurrences in the last 10 minutes. Linked ticket OPS-1247.
Customer impact confirmed - GlobalTech users reporting login failures (CS-1001). Rolling back deployment now.
